exposure: Various treatments for Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) (e.g., dilatation and curettage (D&E) under ultrasound/hysteroscopy, laparotomy, operative resection)
outcome: Hemoglobin changes (preoperative, decline, first after operation)
cohort: The study included 906 patients diagnosed with Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) from January 2013 to December 2018.
finding: Different treatment methods are recommended for specific types of Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) (D&E for Type I, operative resection for Type III(b)), while treatment choice for Type II(a) or Type II(b) remains difficult, and preoperative MTX was associated with more adverse effects.
